display.name: Apple Metal Overview
display.description: A compact starting point for SDK sessions and correlated Apple investigations. Full captures remain local.

display.name: Session
display.description: SDK sessions discovered in the selected measurement time range.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name IN ('game.performance.window','app.responsiveness.window') AND attributes->>'session_id' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session ORDER BY max(start_timestamp) DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Build
display.description: Leave empty to show all records. Paste an exact build ID to filter.

spec.text: Choose a session. Zoom to minutes. Dots show short runs. Open runtime/build links under Events and trace drilldown.

display.name: Recent SDK sessions
display.description: Observed SDK sessions, including sessions with no complete renderer window. CPU is duration-weighted relative to one core. GPU is the worst window p95. Missing values stay empty.

spec.query:
WITH frame AS (
 SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build,
 max(start_timestamp) AS measured, max(attributes->>'render_mode') AS game, count(*) AS frame_windows,
 avg(CAST(attributes->>'render_callback_fps' AS DOUBLE)) AS callback_hz,
 max(CAST(attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS gpu_worst_window_p95_ms
 FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='game.performance.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build)
 GROUP BY session,build
), cpu AS (
 SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session, max(attributes->>'build.id') AS build, max(start_timestamp) AS measured,
 100 * sum(CAST(attributes->>'main_thread.cpu.utilization' AS DOUBLE) * CAST(attributes->>'window_seconds' AS DOUBLE)) / sum(CAST(attributes->>'window_seconds' AS DOUBLE)) AS main_thread_one_core_pct
 FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='app.responsiveness.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build)
 GROUP BY session
)
SELECT coalesce(frame.measured,cpu.measured) AS measured, left(coalesce(frame.session,cpu.session),8) AS session, frame.game, coalesce(frame.frame_windows,0) AS frame_windows,
 round(cpu.main_thread_one_core_pct,1) AS "CPU % (1 core)",
 round(frame.callback_hz,1) AS callback_hz,
 round(frame.gpu_worst_window_p95_ms,2) AS "GPU window p95 ms",
 left(coalesce(frame.build,cpu.build),8) AS build
FROM frame FULL OUTER JOIN cpu ON frame.session=cpu.session
ORDER BY measured DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Native evidence within SDK windows
display.description: Each row is one import and SDK window. Do not sum repeated imports. Waits overlap CPU states. Coverage below 100% limits the conclusion.

spec.query: SELECT left(attributes->>'session_id',8) AS session, left(attributes->>'capture.id',8) AS capture, round(100*CAST(attributes->>'window.coverage_fraction' AS DOUBLE),1) AS coverage_pct, round(CAST(attributes->>'thread.state.Running.ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS running_ms, round(CAST(attributes->>'thread.state.Blocked.ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS blocked_ms, round(CAST(attributes->>'window.drawable_wait_ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS drawable_wait_ms, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='development.thread.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC,capture LIMIT 20

display.name: Investigation findings
display.description: Observations guide the next native investigation. They do not assert an automatic root cause.

spec.query: SELECT left(attributes->>'session_id',8) AS session, attributes->>'diagnostic.observation' AS observation, attributes->>'diagnostic.next_investigation' AS next_investigation, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='development.diagnostic.finding' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

display.name: Main-thread and process CPU activity
display.description: CPU activity as a percentage of one core. Process CPU can exceed 100% across multiple cores. The SDK samples independently of rendering. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp) AS time, concat(metric_name, ' / ', service_name, ' / ', coalesce(service_namespace, ''), ' / ', coalesce(deployment_environment, ''), ' / ', service_instance_id, ' / ', CAST(attributes AS TEXT)) AS series, 100 * MAX(metric_max(value)) AS value FROM metrics WHERE otel_resource_attributes->>'logfire.metric_schema.version'='1' AND ($session = 'all' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND metric_name IN ('app.main_thread.cpu.utilization','app.process.cpu.utilization') GROUP BY time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp), metric_name, service_name, service_namespace, deployment_environment, service_instance_id, attributes ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: SDK raw-frame distribution p95
display.description: Delta histograms contain individual samples from full and partial SDK windows. Bucket quantiles are estimates from histogram bounds, not averages of window p95 values. GPU command sums differ from presentation latency. Series retain mode, workload, GPU timing scope, and source instance. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp) AS time, concat(metric_name, ' / ', service_name, ' / ', coalesce(service_namespace, ''), ' / ', coalesce(deployment_environment, ''), ' / ', service_instance_id, ' / ', CAST(attributes AS TEXT)) AS series, metric_quantile(0.95, value) AS value FROM metrics WHERE otel_resource_attributes->>'logfire.metric_schema.version'='1' AND ($session = 'all' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND metric_name IN ('game.frame.interval','game.renderer.preparation','game.gpu.commands.duration','game.display.present.interval','game.display.present.lateness') GROUP BY time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp), metric_name, service_name, service_namespace, deployment_environment, service_instance_id, attributes ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Inclusive CPU callers by capture
display.description: Up to 20 functions per main/background scope. Each function counts once per running sample, including recursion. Caller weights overlap and must not be summed. Fractions include unresolved running samples. Event-loop ancestors are expected. Filter the session/build and time range.

spec.query: SELECT trace_id, span_id, attributes->>'profile.ended_at' AS measured_end, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'cpu.thread_scope' AS thread_scope, CAST(attributes->>'function.rank' AS DOUBLE) AS rank, attributes->>'function.name' AS function, attributes->>'function.image' AS image, CAST(attributes->>'function.samples' AS DOUBLE) AS samples, CAST(attributes->>'function.inclusive_sampled_weight_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS inclusive_cpu_ms, CAST(attributes->>'function.inclusive_sampled_weight_fraction' AS DOUBLE) AS fraction FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.cpu.caller' ORDER BY measured_end DESC, capture, thread_scope, rank ASC LIMIT 200

display.name: GPU replay encoder and shader costs
display.description: One captured workload replay. Up to three cost-ranked encoders and three cost-ranked shaders from Apple tables. Costs within different scopes overlap. Do not sum them or interpret them as live frame latency, utilization, or CPU waiting. Raw captures and resource contents remain local.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'capture.ended_at' AS captured_end, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'measurement.scope' AS scope, attributes->>'gpu.node.label' AS node, attributes->>'gpu.shader.stage' AS stage, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.replay.duration_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS encoder_ms, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.replay.cost_fraction' AS DOUBLE) AS cost_fraction, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.shader.spilled_bytes' AS DOUBLE) AS spilled_bytes, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.shader.wait_instructions' AS DOUBLE) AS wait_instructions FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.gpu.replay' ORDER BY captured_end DESC, capture, scope, cost_fraction DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: SDK callback and presented FPS
display.description: Callbacks measure renderer cadence. Presented FPS uses Metal drawable presentation timestamps when the app observes drawables. Partial windows retain final samples. Missing presentation data remains absent. Separate sessions stay separate; zoom to a session for detail.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'render_callback_fps' AS DOUBLE), 0)), 0) AS callback_hz, SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'display_presented_fps' AS DOUBLE), 0)), 0) AS presented_fps FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Main-queue completed delay and pending age
display.description: Worst completed probe delay and the maximum age of an unfinished probe in each five-second window. One outstanding probe bounds queued work. A blocked queue stays observable before that probe completes. Probe delay includes scheduling latency. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp) AS time, concat(metric_name, ' / ', service_name, ' / ', coalesce(service_namespace, ''), ' / ', coalesce(deployment_environment, ''), ' / ', service_instance_id, ' / ', CAST(attributes AS TEXT)) AS series, MAX(metric_max(value)) AS value FROM metrics WHERE otel_resource_attributes->>'logfire.metric_schema.version'='1' AND ($session = 'all' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR otel_resource_attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND metric_name IN ('app.main_queue.delay','app.main_queue.pending_age.max') GROUP BY time_bucket('5 seconds', recorded_timestamp), metric_name, service_name, service_namespace, deployment_environment, service_instance_id, attributes ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Whole-host CPU during game observation
display.description: Whole-Mac load while the companion observes a game. Other apps contribute. Command-R alone supplies no host samples. Dots show isolated samples; gaps stay empty.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, 100 * avg(CAST(attributes->>'cpu_utilization' AS DOUBLE)) AS host_cpu_percent FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.host.sample' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'whole_host' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Observed Xcode builds
display.description: The Build filter connects runtime records to builds. The Session filter does not apply here because the build command and app have different sessions. Only companion builds provide complete timing.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, trace_id, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario, CAST(attributes->>'build.duration_seconds' AS DOUBLE) AS seconds, CAST(attributes->>'build.exit_code' AS DOUBLE) AS exit_code, CAST(attributes->>'build.warnings' AS DOUBLE) AS warnings, CAST(attributes->>'build.errors' AS DOUBLE) AS errors FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Xcode aggregate task costs
display.description: Task totals can overlap because compilation runs in parallel. This table cannot identify the critical path or reconstruct task ordering. Open the retained result bundle for detailed Xcode inspection.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'build.id' AS build, trace_id, attributes->>'build.task' AS task, CAST(attributes->>'build.task_seconds' AS DOUBLE) AS aggregate_seconds FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span','log') AND span_name='xcode.build.task_summary' AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC, aggregate_seconds DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Gameplay and scenario events
display.description: Reference-game events keep their measurement dates. Trace and span columns open the real record. Historical obstacle collisions retain game.crash.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS measured, span_name AS event, attributes->>'game' AS game, attributes->>'score' AS score, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name IN ('game.session.started','game.line_clear','game.all_clear','game.hold','game.collision','game.crash','app.state','development.scenario.ready','development.scenario.finished') ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

display.name: Session windows and trace links
display.description: Select one session. Open trace_id or span_id for a report, or build_trace_id for its build. Manual launches can have several independent traces. Full app_session values are filters, not web replay IDs.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS measured, span_name AS report, trace_id, attributes->>'build.trace_id' AS build_trace_id, span_id, attributes->>'session_id' AS app_session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name IN ('game.performance.window','app.responsiveness.window') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
